info.title: Veracode DAST Target Configuration Service API
info.description:
Veracode DAST Target Configuration Service API Documentation
Use one of the following base URLs depending on the region for your account:

  • https://api.veracode.com/ - Veracode US Region (default)
  • https://api.veracode.eu/ - Veracode European Region

parameters.description:
ID of the target's analysis profile. 
If ID is provided, response returns available parent analysis profiles for an analysis profile.
If ID is missing, response returns available parent analysis profiles for the user organization.

parameters.name: include_scanners
parameters.description:
Flag that denotes whether the analysis profile scanners should be included in the response.
If this is set to true, the analysis profile scanners should be included in the response.
If this is set to false, the analysis profile scanners are not returned in the response.
If flag is not included in the request, analysis profile scanners are not provided by default.

Weekday.description: The day of the week on which the schedule triggers. Use this field alone for WEEKLY frequency. For MONTHLY frequency, use this field together with `week_of_month` to schedule by an ordinal weekday. Do not set this field together with `day`.

SchedulingFrequency.description: Enum which represents frequency options for schedule.

interval.description: The recurrence interval. The schedule runs every N units defined by `frequency`.

day.description: The calendar day (1–31) on which the schedule triggers for monthly frequency. Mutually exclusive with `weekday` and `week_of_month`. If the specified day does not exist in a given month (for example, 31 in February), the schedule is skipped for that month. Use -1 to specify the last day of the month.

week_of_month.description: The week of the month for Monthly schedules. Use this field together with `weekday` to schedule by ordinal weekday occurrence. Do not set this field when `day` is used. Valid values: 1–4 (first through fourth occurrence of the weekday), -1 (last occurrence of the weekday in the month), 0 (not set).

max_duration.description: Maximum duration for scan in minutes.

active_from.description: The date the schedule becomes active. The schedule will not trigger before this date. The specified timezone determines the start time.

active_to.description: The date through which the schedule remains active. The schedule does not trigger after this date. The specified timezone determines the end time. If omitted, the schedule runs indefinitely.

ScheduleRequest.description: Request to amend schedule. You can use this request object to create and update target schedule.

interval.description: Recurrence interval. The schedule is suppose to run every N units defined by `frequency`.

day.description: The calendar day (1–31) on which the schedule triggers for monthly frequency. Mutually exclusive with `weekday` and `week_of_month`. If the specified day does not exist in a given month (for example, 31 in February), the schedule is skipped for that month. Use -1 for the last day of the month.

week_of_month.description: The week of the month for Monthly schedules. Use this field together with `weekday` to schedule by ordinal weekday occurrence. Do not set this field when `day` is used. Valid values: 1–4 (first through fourth occurrence of the weekday), -1 (last occurrence of the weekday in the month), 0 (not set).

max_duration.description: Maximum duration for scan in minutes.

active_from.description: Date from which the schedule becomes active. The schedule will not trigger before this moment. The timezone specified determines when the schedule starts.

active_to.description: The date through which the schedule remains active. The schedule does not trigger after this date. The specified timezone determines when the schedule ends. If omitted, the schedule runs indefinitely.

first_run_at.description: The date-time of the first scheduled trigger at or after `active_from`, based on the schedule configuration and timezone rules. Null if no valid future occurrences exist.

next_run_at.description: The date-time of the next scheduled trigger. Null if the schedule is EXPIRED or has no future occurrences.

final_run_at.description: The computed date-time of the final scheduled trigger. Present only when `end_after` is set, otherwise null.

status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the schedule:
INACTIVE:
  The schedule has not yet become active and is not eligible to trigger.

ACTIVE:
  The schedule is currently active and eligible to trigger.

EXPIRED:
  The schedule has ended and will no longer trigger.
  The end condition defined by `active_to` has been reached.
